titulo: Real rescuers came from the other side 🔦 Part 3 #horror #shorts
descripcion:
On day thirteen, two lights came. One from the deep end. One from above. I had to choose.

Which light would you trust?

Narrated fiction. New part every day.
#horror #horrorstories #scarystories #survival #creepypasta

lineas.texto: Part three. The light kept knocking our signal, calling me down.
I didn't move. I sat with my back to the rock for seven days.
On day thirteen, I heard engines, and voices, and something splashed in from above.
Two divers with ropes, coming from the shaft, shouting my name.
Behind them, in the deep end, the other light went dark, and stayed dark.
Later the army told me their team was the only one in the water. Nobody came from below.
They never found Ramon. Whatever lives down there learned our knock, and used it on him.
If you're ever trapped underground, help comes from above. Never swim toward a light from below.
